# Vendored from `interactions.openapi.json`'s `InteractionSseEventInteraction`
# schema (the partial resource nested in `interaction.completed`/
# `interaction.created` events) -- its real `status` `enum` values. Note this
# is a SEPARATE, shorter vocabulary than the full `Interaction`/
# `CreateModelInteractionParams.status` enum (which also has
# `budget_exceeded`/`queued`) -- the streaming lifecycle partial resource only
# ever reports these six.
in_progress
requires_action
completed
failed
cancelled
incomplete
